name: Tahngarth
description: The hulking minotaur of the Weatherlight crew.

description_citations.text: "Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth eyes Squee as bait to trap Avizoa.
timeline.quote: "Maybe we can trap them with bait," thought Tahngarth, eyeing Squee.

citation.text: Avizoa (Weatherlight, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Three years later Gerrard asks Mirri to be his Lieutenant and she rejoins the crew to rescue Captain Sisay.
timeline.quote: Gerrard and Mirri both were instrumental in stopping the rampaging monster

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mirri dives in front of Crovax to deflect Selenia's strike and is gravely wounded; Crovax slays Selenia and Tahngarth carries both back to the ship.
timeline.quote: Mirri dove in front of him to deflect one of Selenia's strikes.

citation.text: "Mirri", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew takes Karn, Tahngarth and the Legacy artifacts hostage while Gerrard is knocked overboard.
timeline.quote: When Weatherlight planeshifted to Rath, it was ambushed by the Predator

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven and Predator is destroyed by being sent crashing into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Greven himself was killed by Tahngarth.

citation.text: "Predator", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A volcanic dragon forces her ship to land near the Talruum Mountains, where Tahngarth fights as her champion and joins her crew.
timeline.quote: He joined her crew and quickly proved himself.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew recovers the Juju Bubble in the Adarkar Wastes; Meida is killed and Tahngarth becomes first mate.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth later took her place as first mate.

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Early Years". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Weatherlight planeshifts to Rath and is ambushed and boarded by the Predator, whose crew take hostages.
timeline.quote: Predator' s crew took Karn , Tahngarth , and the Legacy artifacts hostage

citation.text: "Skyship Weatherlight", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in the Talruum Mountains; Tahngarth fights as Sisay's champion, defeats Ghentoth and joins her crew.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth offered to fight as Sisay's champion and proved himself by defeating Ghentoth.

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Meida is killed in the Adarkar Wastes, Tahngarth becomes Sisay's first mate.
timeline.quote: he took her place as Sisay's first mate

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard quits the crew after Rofellos is killed at Crovax's Estate, confirming Tahngarth's suspicion.
timeline.quote: especially when the man quit the Weatherlight crew after the attack on Crovax's Estate

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Weatherlight". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth easily bests Greven.
timeline.quote: The match between Tahngarth and Greven was close only in the mind of the minotaur.

citation.text: Hand to Hand (Tempest, 1997), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Greven begins mutating the captured Tahngarth into a Phyrexian as a replacement for Vhati.
timeline.quote: Greven, therefore, began mutating the minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Volrath's enforcer". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Predator intercepts Weatherlight at Urborg; Greven's mind is dominated by Crovax and Tahngarth kills him.
timeline.quote: Greven soon fell beneath the raging minotaur

citation.text: "Greven il-Vec", section "Demise". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and Tahngarth are captured and Gerrard is thrown overboard, so Hanna takes charge of the ship.
timeline.quote: Hanna took charge of the ship with Mirri 's support and landed the ship in the forest below.

citation.text: "Hanna", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth convinces Gerrard to rejoin the crew after Sisay is taken to Rath.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth convinced Gerrard to rejoin the crew to help his friends

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Rath the Predator attacks; Karn and the Legacy treasury are taken, and Tahngarth jumps to save Karn but is overpowered and captured by Greven il-Vec.
timeline.quote: he was overpowered by Greven il -Vec and captured as well

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth is mutated by the Phyrexians under Volrath, then freed before the process completes; he helps free Sisay and the crew escapes to Mercadia.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth had been mutated by the Phyrexians

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Volrath has Sisay abducted to lure the Weatherlight to Rath, ambushes it, and captures Tahngarth, Karn and the Legacy artifacts; Gerrard falls over Skyshroud Forest.
timeline.quote: He organized the abduction of Sisay to lure Weatherlight to Rath

citation.text: "Volrath", section "Rath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth declares Volrath has killed him, leaving only the scar.
timeline.quote: Volrath has killed me.

citation.text: Torment (Stronghold, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Alaric kills himself with the poisoned wine at Gerrard's suggestion.
timeline.quote: Alaric, at his former friend Gerrard's suggestion, decides to kill himself with the wine to save his reputation.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard rejoins the Weatherlight and appoints Tahngarth first mate.
timeline.quote: Gerrard is introduced to old and new crewmates and appoints Tahngarth as the first mate

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Gerrard's Tale", by Michael Ryan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: An aboroth chases the Weatherlight until elvish war machines stop it.
timeline.quote: The monster pursues the Weatherlight, almost catching its sails when it is stopped by elvish war machines.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard defeats the aboroth with the Thran Forge and the Touchstone.
timeline.quote: Gerrard turned the aboroth into metal pieces with the Thran forge and then deactivated it with the Touchstone

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth admits that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth begrudgingly admits to Orim that the Weatherlight needs Gerrard

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Tahngarth's Tale" ( Hannovi Braddock )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth stows away on the Predator.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth grabbed a rope and stowed away on the Predator as it flew away.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn refuses to kill his torturers in the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Karn resolves to remain to stand and not kill any of his torturers

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Karn's Tale" ( J. Robert King )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth but finds only a shapeshifter in place of Sisay.
timeline.quote: It turned out to be a shapeshifter, however

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Selenia's shards stream into Crovax and Tahngarth saves him from jumping.
timeline.quote: Selenia shatters into countless shards that stream into Crovax's body through his face.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""Crovax's Tale" ( Kij Johnson )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth returns mutilated, carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth reappears, emerging from the Stronghold mutilated by Volrath's tortures and carrying the wounded Mirri and Crovax.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth commandeers an ornithopter to try to pick up Gerrard.
timeline.quote: the minotaur jumps aboard the ornithopter and takes control of it

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section ""The Weatherlight's Tale" ( Francis Lebaron )". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Tahngarth kill Volrath, whose body shapeshifts.
timeline.quote: The two killed Volrath, but the body shapeshifted into one of Volrath's experiments.

citation.text: "Rath and Storm", section "A Dark Room". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth orders defenders to hold position.
timeline.quote: Hold your position! Leave doubt for the dying!

citation.text: Staunch Defenders (World Championship Decks 1998, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth advises looking at your feet while trampling an enemy.
timeline.quote: Look at your feet while you trample him.

citation.text: Overrun (Anthologies, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: In 4195 AR Sisay and Tahngarth find the Juju Bubble in the Adarkar Wastes; a war beast attacks and first mate Meida dies.
timeline.quote: though first mate Meida lost her life in the scuffle.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In Llanowar Gerrard uses the Thran Forge and Touchstone to turn an aboroth into dust, showing Tahngarth his connection to the Legacy.
timeline.quote: This is what made Tahngarth realize the special connection Gerrard had with the Legacy artifacts.

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Gerrard, Tahngarth and Karn are arrested in Mercadia, Sisay, Hanna and Orim strike a deal with the Chief Magistrate to travel to Saprazzo for the Power Matrix.
timeline.quote: After the arrest of Gerrard , Tahngarth , and Karn in Mercadia

citation.text: "The Legacy", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth glances at Takara who is unaffected by the specter's wail.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth glanced at Takara.

citation.text: Specter's Wail (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth roars at Squee being called general.
timeline.quote: General *nuisance*, maybe.

citation.text: Squee, Goblin Nabob (Mercadian Masques, 1999), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A cateran enforcer submits to Squee, allowing the crew to escape.
timeline.quote: At the sight of Squee, the cateran enforcer stops and seeks pardon from the goblin.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth confesses that he wishes he had died on Rath rather than live with the changes Volrath made.
timeline.quote: He wishes he had died there instead of having to live with the twisted changes effected upon him by Volrath.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garbage falls on Xcric instead of the condemned Gerrard, Karn and Tahngarth.
timeline.quote: what they see is tons of filth fall right on top of Xcric!

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard and Sisay are pulled aboard the Weatherlight, which Karn now controls through its engine.
timeline.quote: Now a rope comes down and Hanna and Tahngarth pull the two up on board.

citation.text: "Mercadian Masques (novel)", section "Chapter by chapter summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rebels storm the Subterranean Hangar and destroy the Phyrexian fleet; the Weatherlight is reclaimed.
timeline.quote: they destroyed the Phyrexian fleet assembled in preparation for the coming invasion of Dominaria

citation.text: "Revolution on Mercadia", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands on Mercadia and the Cho-Arrim steal the ship.
timeline.quote: he could not prevent the rebels from stealing the ship

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth tells Hanna he feels himself a monster and sees his mutation as punishment for his vanity.
timeline.quote: he admitted that he felt himself a monster now

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The crew finds Orim alive among the Cho-Arrim and learns of the myths of Ramos.
timeline.quote: they found Orim alive and flourishing

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Mercadia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth mocks Squee about a giant's meal.
timeline.quote: "Faugh!" snorted Tahngarth.

citation.text: Lowland Giant (Beatdown Box Set, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth roars as he repays an enemy for his stay on Rath.
timeline.quote: Now I'll repay you for my stay on Rath!

citation.text: Maniacal Rage (Invasion, 2000), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: At the Stronghold Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Karn takes control of the Predator; Ertai steals Gerrard and Squee to Crovax, who sends Gerrard into Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: In a duel, Tahngarth killed Greven il-Vec and Karn took control of the Predator

citation.text: "Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria", section "Second stage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year after the Invasion, Karn takes Orim back to Mercadia, and Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee receive a new vessel named Victory.
timeline.quote: which she named Victory

citation.text: "Sisay", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight destroys the Phyrexian mutation plants among the Hurloon, and survivors accept Tahngarth as their champion.
timeline.quote: the Hurloon survivors all bowed down before Tahngarth and accepted him as their champion

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec in a rematch between Weatherlight and Predator.
timeline.quote: cleaving the commander's head in two

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth hacks at Yawgmoth's tentacles, buying time for Gerrard, Urza and Karn to complete the Legacy and destroy Yawgmoth.
timeline.quote: This brave defiance bought Gerrard, Urza, and Karn enough time to complete the Legacy and destroy Yawgmoth.

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "The Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Predator attacks the Weatherlight; Tahngarth kills Greven il-Vec and Sisay crashes the Predator into the Stronghold.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth duels with Greven il -Vec and kills him

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A year later Freyalise erects a monument, and Karn, as an accumulation of the Legacy, takes Orim to Mercadia while Sisay, Squee and Tahngarth sail on the Victory.
timeline.quote: One year later, in a ceremony attended by survivors from all over the globe

citation.text: "Apocalypse (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight crash-lands in Skyshroud and Tahngarth is caught by Greven before he can rescue Karn.
timeline.quote: was caught by Greven before he could rescue Karn.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Karn refuses to fight when taken to witness Tahngarth's mutation.
timeline.quote: refused to fight, believing that remorse would outlast rage.

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The rescue party frees Karn and Tahngarth, but the 'Sisay' they find is a shapeshifter.
timeline.quote: They successfully freed Karn and Tahngarth

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth leaps onto the final ornithopter and crashes it before leaping to safety.
timeline.quote: Tahngarth climbed a tree and leaped onto the enemy craft

citation.text: "Assault on Rath", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight is absorbed in the completed Legacy; Dominarians grant Sisay, Tahngarth and Squee a new ship, Victory.
timeline.quote: which Sisay named Victory

citation.text: "Tahngarth", section "Weatherlight's Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gerrard hears Tahngarth roaring at a missionary of the Church of Angelfire on the docks and runs to calm him.
timeline.quote: "Uh oh," Gerrard murmured, and broke into a run.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard talks Tahngarth out of killing the missionary, and the two are reunited.
timeline.quote: "Easy, Tahngarth," he murmured, taking the Talruum's arm.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Tahngarth tells Gerrard they came to find him because something terrible has happened to Sisay.
timeline.quote: something terrible has happened.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Sisay tells Tahngarth she has agreed to help rescue Starke's daughter from Volrath in exchange for information about the Legacy.
timeline.quote: This servant, Volrath, is holding Starke's daughter prisoner.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Sisay predicts that Gerrard will never be free of the Legacy.
timeline.quote: He'll never be free of the Legacy. He just doesn't know it yet.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight, without Sisay aboard, sets sail for Benalia.
timeline.quote: The following morning, the Weatherlight , without Sisay aboard, set sail for Benalia.

citation.text: "Maelstrom" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard, Tahngarth and Crovax, who rescued Starke from Maraxus's camp, walk through a canyon and Tahngarth carries the weakened Starke.
timeline.quote: since the trio had rescued Starke from Maraxus of Keld's camp

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Maraxus and his ogre platoon find the sleeping group at dawn and attack, demanding Starke.
timeline.quote: "Give me the traitor," Maraxus demanded of Gerrard

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.

timeline.summary: Gerrard sends Tahngarth, Crovax and Starke to the ship to leave him alone against Maraxus, whose strength depends on those around him.
timeline.quote: that you draw your strength from whatever's around you, whoever's near. Look around. You're alone.

citation.text: "Torrent" by Michael G. Ryan. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Feb 2007.
